resources.string: This QR code has no dialable peer address. Include the IP/DNS, transport, and /p2p/PeerID.
best_path selects an existing path using topology priority and write performance; redundant duplicates over existing streams; fallback tries existing paths in order. Changes require a VPN restart.
Use complete multiaddrs ending in /p2p/PeerID. Static peers can also connect through relays. Changes restart the VPN.
